verso-shell.description: Session grants for Verso's shell-owned pages: the overview meters + WAN graph, the Services table and its start/stop, connected devices, the network/firewall/zone views, the live activity stream's read of the log ring, and Verso's own settings config. Declares every ubus object and uci config the shell reads or controls, so the shell depends on no other package's ACL files — in particular not LuCI's, which the dev image happens to ship but a production image need not.
